owner: A8 local, source-backed presentation and local walkability metadata; no world simulation

coordinate_system.site_space: A8 local scene pixels; origin at scene top-left; tile size 16 px

authority_boundaries.a8: Owns local class labels, authored surface overlays, fixed local water blockers, boardwalk walkability, and truthful presentation of its own projected site state.
authority_boundaries.a0: Owns production shell mount, world-size/topology, transitions, global return coordinates, weather/time/tide/site projections, SaveService persistence and owner receipts.
authority_boundaries.a1: Owns canonical cells, route geography, surface/material evidence, and world transforms.
authority_boundaries.a3: Owns Quarry binding/permission, costs, yields, and cooldowns. A8 surface or site identity is never A3 permission.

current_a0_source_support.world_time: UNKNOWN; the current A0 head keeps an active_seconds field in a legacy world binding, but does not publish an approved per-site presentation projection to A8.
current_a0_source_support.weather: UNKNOWN; current A0 head has no approved weather source/schema or per-site presentation projection for these sites.
current_a0_source_support.tide: UNKNOWN; A1 has other-region tide evidence, not an authorized value for these three sites.
current_a0_source_support.site_state: Only a separately validated A0 owner projection may change persistent site presentation.

mud.trace_affordance: local metadata only; does not emit, persist, or discover footprints
mud.weather_effect: UNKNOWN unless an A0-owned source projection and A8-authored visual mapping are both present

snow.trace_affordance: local metadata only; does not emit, persist, or discover footprints
snow.weather_effect: UNKNOWN unless an A0-owned source projection and A8-authored visual mapping are both present

stone.physical_effect: authored collision only; no speed, stamina, damage, or noise values

plank.physical_effect: fixed authored walkable crossing over the locally blocked water channel
plank.weather_effect: cannot change collision or close retreat

shallow_water.source_evidence: UNKNOWN for current A8 sites; A1/A0 do not provide per-site depth values.
shallow_water.physical_effect: blocked unless an authored plank crossing exists

deep_water.source_evidence: UNKNOWN for current A8 sites; A1/A0 do not provide per-site depth values.
deep_water.physical_effect: blocked; no A8 swimming, drowning, or damage simulation

water_unknown_depth.physical_effect: blocked except at the authored, fixed boardwalk crossing

zones.physical_effect: Existing walls and owner-state route blockers only.
zones.exposure: UNKNOWN; no A0 weather or shelter projection is available.

authored_exposure_routes.retreat: same doorway remains physically open; no weather-dependent collision

zones.physical_effect: Solid left/right bank-water collision with a 32 px bridge gap; a separate owner-state deadfall blocker closes that gap until orchard_channel=flowing.
zones.state_visual: The water itself remains visible in UNKNOWN, untouched, and flowing states; owner-projected flow removes the deadfall cue and reveals the fixed boardwalk.

zones.physical_effect: visual only; ordinary walkability is determined by authored collision

zones.collision_effect: The water blocker gap is fixed; only the owner-projected deadfall blocker opens or closes the approach.
zones.weather_effect: never blocks this local retreat or crossing

authored_exposure_routes.retreat: fixed boardwalk and south doorway remain available in every weather value; channel blocker changes only after owner projection

zones.physical_effect: Solid left/right water blockers; only the fixed 32 px plank bridge is walkable. The existing salvage/state gate above remains A8-owned site geometry under owner state.

zones.collision_effect: fixed, independent of time, weather, tide, and wheel state

authored_exposure_routes.retreat: the fixed boardwalk and south doorway are independent of wheel power and weather

non_features: No A8 global footprints, persistent tracks, pursuit, home targeting, raids, or discovery.
No second world clock or elapsed-time rates.
No weather-driven collision or unsafe return.
No A8 movement modifiers, hazard damage, swimming, or survival consequences.
No inferred water depth, tide, temperature, rainfall, or shelter value.
